method: Direct FBX evaluation with ufbx fcc5d6ba444cfd3eb80677dba5e37e493941abe5 at the embedded 30 fps take keyframes; no Unity process used.
coordinateNote: The reported tip is the farthest rigid weapon-mesh vertex transformed to model world space. Positive Z is character forward in these source files.
limitation: The FBX takes contain no explicit gameplay hit/release events. Contact keyframes are geometric measurements: blade crossing/forward extremum for melee, the aimed-pose-to-recoil boundary for ranged, and the forward extremum for spellcast.

contacts.evidence: The sword crosses the forward arc and reaches tip Z 1.741751. At frame 7 Z is 1.145321; at frame 9 it has passed left and Z falls to 1.523494. At normalized 0.5 it is already held in follow-through at Z 0.356089.
The two-handed sword crosses center near X -0.232429 and reaches its maximum forward tip Z 2.295638.
The crossbow reaches the aimed high pose at frame 8; backward Z recoil begins at frame 9.
The staff reaches its forward release extremum, tip Z 1.860532, at frame 9 before recovery.

procedural.evidence: These are code-authored contact curves rather than imported FBX takes.
